summary: BioNexus Gene Lab Corp. filed an 8-K reporting a press release on July 28, 2026, announcing progress in the Southeast Asian rollout of its VitaGuard MRD platform after a working visit to Tongshu Gene facilities in China. The filing describes technical planning, hospital visits, and next steps for commercialization; no financial terms, transactions, or special-situation events are disclosed. This is a routine operational update, not a special situation.
